description: Search the ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database by name for offshore entities, officers (directors/shareholders/beneficiaries) and intermediaries (registered agents, law firms, banks) named across five ICIJ investigations: Offshore Leaks, Panama Papers, Bahamas Leaks, Paradise Papers and Pandora Papers. Answers "is [name] in the Panama Papers", "offshore companies registered in [jurisdiction]", "who is [person] linked to offshore". Matches on name (prefix-aware, e.g. "Mossack" matches "Mossack Fonseca"). Returns each match's node_id, type, jurisdiction, status and which leak it came from -- call offshore_entity with a node_id for full details and linked officers/intermediaries. Every response carries ICIJ's own licence attribution and its caveat that inclusion is not evidence of wrongdoing.

jurisdiction.description: Filter by jurisdiction name as ICIJ records it, e.g. "British Virgin Islands", "Panama". Exact match, case-insensitive.

name.description: Name (or part of a name) to search for, e.g. "Mossack Fonseca", "Wintris".

node_type.description: Restrict to one kind of node: "entity" (offshore company/trust/foundation), "officer" (director/shareholder/beneficiary), "intermediary" (registered agent/law firm/bank), "address", or "other".

name: offshore_search
title: Offshore Search
